book: Lambert Daneau's 1580 Geneva edition of Peter Lombard's first book of Sentences, with Daneau's commentary, prolegomena, synopsis and index: front matter, then Prolegomena and Lombard's Distinctiones I-XLVIII, each with Daneau's notes.
